description: Full public record for one sleeve: stats, the stocks-only return vs SPY (`invested`), indexed performance curve (100 = inception), drawdown series, and the complete submitted-order log. `status` is `live` or `retired` (meanrev: the negative control, retired 2026-11-13; its record is complete). For `robo` (index-fund policy portfolio) the record also has `policy`: the pinned mix with bands and current weights, `yardstick` (its return beside its own mix of the same funds, dividends included; SPY for context only — never describe it as beating or trailing the market) and its six pre-registered `checks`. All figures are SIMULATED paper trading.

include.description: stats = summary only; curve (alias: equity) = + indexed performance/drawdown series; trades = + full order log; all = everything

sleeve.description: Which sleeve to fetch (meanrev is retired: a complete, frozen record)

name: sleeve_record
